SynapseRust Agent Framework

ReAct · RAG · MultiAgent · MCP · A2A · WASM

Quick Start
GitHub

🚀 Production-Ready Core

Runnable, Graph, Chain, ReAct Agent. 279 tests passing. Apache 2.0.

🤖 4 MultiAgent Patterns

Router, Orchestrator, Handoff, Hybrid. Nested composition. LLM-driven and rule-based.

📚 RAG Out of the Box

4 chunkers (Character/Recursive/Markdown/Token), OpenAI embedding, in-memory vector store.

🔌 MCP + A2A

Model Context Protocol (stdio + HTTP + Server). Agent-to-Agent protocol. Cross-process.

📝 Session Event Log

Append-only event persistence. FileEventStore with JSON Lines format.

🌊 Waterfall Events

5 dispatch modes (emit/parallel/serial/bail/waterfall). Interceptor pattern.

🔄 LLM Retry Policy

Exponential backoff with jitter. Configurable retryable error codes.

🏷️ Tool Namespace

Scoped skill registration. MCP-style qualified names (mcp__server__tool).

🌐 WASM Sandbox Ready

Cross-platform HttpClient. Run agents in wasi sandboxes (PFC runtime).

🛡️ Type-Safe Rust

Async-native, no Python runtime, type-safe agent composition.

Synapse's unique strengths:

  • A2A protocol — First-class cross-process agent communication with persistent task storage
  • WASM isolation — Run agents in wasi sandboxes (PFC runtime)
  • MultiAgent 4-mode coverage — Router, Orchestrator, Handoff, Hybrid
  • MCP Server — Build custom MCP servers with SimpleMcpServer
  • Type-safe Rust API — No Python runtime overhead, async-native
  • 229 tests — Comprehensive unit + integration coverage, all mocked
